content.value_statement: Creators often need one video asset in several aspect ratios without reshooting. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through RunComfy video outpainting workflows.
actual_capabilities: Guides RunComfy CLI use for Wan 2-7 edit-video.
Drafts prompts for 9:16 to 16:9 and other canvas extensions.
Explains when to use ComfyUI workflows for better seam quality.
Identifies related RunComfy video skills and model catalog pages.
Documents CLI exit codes, token storage, and output directory behavior.
limitations: Requires a RunComfy account, CLI access, and a source video URL.
The CLI path uses prompt-based editing, not a dedicated outpaint endpoint.
Hero-grade seams may require a separate ComfyUI workflow.
Does not handle still-image outpainting, temporal extension, or mask inpainting.

use_cases.title: Adapt social clips for YouTube
use_cases.description: Turn vertical short-form footage into a wider frame while preserving the central subject.

use_cases.title: Prepare campaign hero assets
use_cases.description: Expand a product or creator video for banners, landing pages, and paid media placements.

use_cases.title: Modernize older video framing
use_cases.description: Plan an outpainting route for 4:3 or square clips that need modern widescreen delivery.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner aspect ratio change
prompt_templates.scenario: Convert a simple vertical clip into a wide version.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the video-outpainting skill to extend my vertical clip to 16:9. Keep the subject centered and match the original background.

prompt_templates.title: Social repurpose workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a delivery plan for a social video adaptation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a RunComfy video outpainting workflow for this clip. Recommend prompt wording, expected quality risks, and the right output review checks.

prompt_templates.title: Quality-sensitive expansion
prompt_templates.scenario: Decide between the CLI route and a ComfyUI workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate whether Wan 2-7 edit-video is enough for this outpaint. If seam quality is critical, route me to the better ComfyUI workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced multi-pass outpaint
prompt_templates.scenario: Extend a video in stages while managing quality loss.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a two-pass video outpainting approach. Specify the first extension, second extension, preservation language, and when to stop.

output_examples.input: Extend a vertical product clip into a wide launch teaser.
output_examples.output: Recommended route: Wan 2-7 edit-video. Use a prompt that adds matching side environment, keeps lighting consistent, and preserves the product action.

output_examples.input: Convert older 4:3 footage into a modern 16:9 presentation.
output_examples.output: Recommended route: ComfyUI outpainting workflow. The skill would flag seam quality and temporal consistency as higher risks for this source.

output_examples.input: Make a square creator video fit a landing page hero area.
output_examples.output: Recommended route: start with the CLI workflow, review edge motion carefully, and switch to ComfyUI if the expanded borders flicker.

best_practices: Start prompts with the target canvas change and aspect ratio.
Describe the environment, lighting, depth, and camera distance to extend.
Review seam areas and edge motion before publishing the final video.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill to extend video duration or add new frames in time.
Do not expect prompt-only editing to solve strict hero-grade seam requirements.
Do not pass source video URLs that the user did not explicitly provide.

faq.question: What does video outpainting mean?
faq.answer: It expands the visible frame around a video while trying to preserve the original action and subject.

faq.question: Does this skill run the outpainting model directly?
faq.answer: It guides use of the RunComfy CLI and points to ComfyUI workflows when the CLI route is not enough.

faq.question: Can it turn vertical clips into horizontal clips?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented workflow targets changes such as 9:16 vertical footage to 16:9 horizontal footage.

faq.question: When should I use ComfyUI instead?
faq.answer: Use ComfyUI when seam quality, motion consistency, or hero advertising output needs stricter control.

faq.question: Does it edit objects inside the original frame?
faq.answer: No. For mask-driven internal edits, use a video inpainting workflow instead.

faq.question: What inputs do I need?
faq.answer: You need access to RunComfy, a source video URL, and a clear description of the desired canvas extension.
